name: gencheck
description: Verify the seller before your agent pays. GenCheck asks GenLayer validators whether a checkout URL is the claimed brand's real seller or a lookalike scam, and blocks payment unless the answer is an explicit yes.

plugins.name: gencheck
plugins.description: Fail-closed pre-payment trust gate. Before an agent signs or sends payment for a checkout URL, GenLayer validators independently fetch the page and the brand's official site and vote on whether this is the real seller. Anything other than an explicit yes blocks.
